description: This file contains the PHP class 'Country' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation' namespace. It defines methods for managing country records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving country data, as well as counting total records based on various filters.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A model class for managing country data within the localisations namespace of the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Inserts a new country record into the database using the provided data array.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Updates an existing country record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Deletes a country record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific country by its ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Fetches a country record based on its ISO 2-code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Fetches a country record based on its ISO 3-code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of countries, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCountries
methods.description: Returns the total number of countries, optionally filtered by name or ISO codes.

methods.name: getTotalCountriesByAddressFormatId
methods.description: Returns the total number of countries associated with a specific address format ID.
